reconciliation.decision: Portable contracts and accepted amendments consolidated; issue histories and implementation gaps retained only as provenance, not normative text.
CEL profile replaces older ICU proposals; binding paths and expression own-key access are distinguished.
Tuple-wide options.detail places positions; registry position detail describes a dialog. options.layout only sizes a child.
Save formats hex, hex3, rgb and hsb, verified against renderer-common colorFormat.ts.
Both schema length bounds are required; otherwise ordinary password presentation.
Use numeric UI format bounds in portable examples; schema-side numeric comparison requires a separate validator extension and is excluded from the Ajv-compatible data-schema authoring profile.
Picker selections enforce bounds under restrict. Complete typed range violations may commit with validation feedback; no silent clamping.
Timezone selectors remain non-normative. Dynamic overlay and pending-validity contracts do not imply reference implementation support.
Single public package; Changesets release PR/publish on master, Node 22, pnpm 10.28.2 and GitHub Pages, following jsonforms-svelte workflows.
Converted the isolated prefixItems tuple to equivalent draft-07 positional items; the entire fixture now uses one declared dialect with actual positional validation.
At most one open category, including persistent explicit all-closed state, follows the accepted amendment and reference interaction.
Remaining pickup-related field names replaced with projectContact, officeCity and startsOn in the standalone examples.

additionalReconciliationNotes: Retain the portable flat config.restrict spelling. Require host resolution before core defaults are injected; document the reference implementation namespaced spelling as adapter compatibility rather than a second canonical setting.
Reconcile temporal text range feedback with picker prevention across both the shared restrict section and the temporal catalog.
Image-data opt-in admits SVG images in the reference URL policy; hosts may apply a narrower MIME policy.

Published schemas are limited to implemented authoring features. Removed the speculative $dynamic overlay vocabulary and vectors, reserved layout hints, unconsumed type-detail/dialog settings, and unverified read-only separation opt-in. TODO.md tracks design versus implementation work; the implemented Label interpolation dynamicValues gate remains.
Removed the custom data-schema meta-schema: use the standard JSON Schema meta-schema supplied by the validator. Custom extension keywords are not checked by standard meta-schema validation.

2026-09-27 source audit: all 15 hashes and all 32 example directories verified; 156 JSON assets accounted for. Added standalone rules and corrected core/config/option coverage. Core settings are described separately from renderer support. See AUDIT.md for evidence and remaining adapter differences.

Configuration follow-up: traced every previously declared config path. Removed 30 unsupported or misleading global declarations, added 9 confirmed config paths, and recorded evidence and merge behavior in conformance/config-consumption.json and AUDIT.md. Structural label/detail/summary/cell options remain local authoring choices despite isolated merged-config readers.
